messages:
Marta: Quick design review: vectors preview + rerank table. Two areas I want eyes on: export CSV column order and SR/keyboard flow for inline relevance edits.

Sam: For exports, I think order should be: id, text, embedding_id, score, relevance_label. Puts the numeric score next to text for quick analysis.

Leo: Agree on score next to text. Minor: name the score column \"model_score\" to avoid ambiguity across models.

Aisha: Accessibility: when a user edits the relevance label (dropdown), announce changes with aria-live=\"polite\" and include previous + new value, e.g., \"Relevance changed from neutral to relevant.\" Also ensure the dropdown has an aria-label like \"Relevance for row 12\".

Marta: Good call. Keyboard flow proposal: focus lands on table after import, pressing Enter on a row opens a compact inline editor (not a modal). Escape closes editor and returns focus to the row. Thoughts?

Sam: Inline editor is better for context. Add a small keyboard hint visible on focus: \"Enter to edit, / to search, e to toggle score sort\". Keep it low-contrast but accessible.

Leo: Sorting affordance: make score sorting a toggle button in header with aria-pressed. Default is descending. Also show visual caret and SR text: \"Sorted by model_score, descending\".

Aisha: Contrast nit: score color (green/red) fails 3:1 on small text. Use icons + color and ensure text labels like \"High\"/\"Low\" are visible. For color-only cues, add aria-hidden icons while SR gets text.

design-bot: Export preview generated: rows=25, cols=[id,text,embedding_id,model_score,relevance_label], sample_link=https://figma.com/file/preview123

Marta: Copy for export modal: header \"Export relevance CSV\". Body: \"Includes current filters and sort. Exported file will contain columns: id, text, embedding_id, model_score, relevance_label.\" Buttons: primary \"Export CSV\" secondary \"Cancel\". Any suggestions?

Sam: Maybe change body to call out privacy: \"This export includes unredacted text from your dataset. Only download if you have permission.\" short and bolded? (we'll mark in UI).

Aisha: Also add a sr-only summary for the exported file: \"CSV: 25 rows, 5 columns; includes model scores and user-assigned labels.\" That helps screen reader users confirm contents before download.

Leo: Rerank preview: when toggling rerank vs original order, animate crossfade not slide to avoid layout shift. Provide a tiny toast: \"Reranked using model v3.1 (deterministic)\", with link to details.

Marta: UX microcopy for inline label guide: \"Label meaning: Relevant = matches intent, Neutral = borderline, Irrelevant = not useful. Click ? for examples.\" The ? opens a short tooltip.

Sam: One more: export filename pattern: `vectors_export_{date}_{filter}.csv`. Make date in ISO-ish `2026-03-23` to be explicit.

Aisha: Keyboard accessible tooltip note: tooltips must appear on focus as well as hover and use role=\"tooltip\" with aria-describedby pointing to the trigger.

Marta: Great. I'll update the Figma and the copy doc. I'll include the SR strings Aisha suggested and tag you for a final pass. Thanks all.
